_about: Areas of work and what is being done in each now. Project names only, no internal details. These are not the formal working groups in GOVERNANCE (none is formed yet); they are where work happens today. Read by the website community page and the Discord bridge bot. Update when work starts, finishes or needs help; keep it short and true.
